3.name: Sacred Weapon & Devotion Spells (Oath of Devotion)
3.description: Keep Devotion spells prepared and expend Channel Divinity as part of an attack to add your CHA modifier to weapon attack rolls and emit bright light.

7.name: Aura of Devotion (Oath of Devotion)
7.description: You and allies inside your Aura of Protection have Immunity to the Charmed condition.

15.name: Smite of Protection (Oath of Devotion)
15.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and allies in your Aura of Protection gain Half Cover until the start of your next turn.

20.name: Holy Nimbus (Oath of Devotion)
20.description: Emit Sunlight for 10 minutes as a Bonus Action, granting Advantage on saves against Fiend/Undead spells and dealing CHA mod + PB Radiant damage in your aura.

3.name: Inspiring Smite & Peerless Athlete (Oath of Glory)
3.description: Keep Glory spells prepared and spend Channel Divinity for athletic prowess or to grant Temporary HP after casting Divine Smite.

7.name: Aura of Alacrity (Oath of Glory)
7.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and any ally who enters your Aura of Protection gains +10 feet Speed until the end of their next turn.

15.name: Glorious Defense (Oath of Glory)
15.description: Use your Reaction to add CHA modifier to a nearby ally's AC against an attack and counterattack the attacker if it misses (CHA mod uses per Long Rest).

20.name: Living Legend (Oath of Glory)
20.description: For 10 minutes as a Bonus Action, gain Advantage on CHA checks, turn missed weapon attacks into hits, and reroll failed saving throws via Reaction.

inspiring_smite.name: Inspiring Smite
inspiring_smite.hint: Channel Divinity after Divine Smite: distribute 2d8 + Paladin level Temporary HP among allies within 30 ft.

3.name: Nature's Wrath & Ancients Spells (Oath of the Ancients)
3.description: Keep Ancients spells prepared and expend Channel Divinity as a Magic action to conjure spectral vines that restrain nearby creatures.

7.name: Aura of Warding (Oath of the Ancients)
7.description: You and allies inside your Aura of Protection gain Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

15.name: Undying Sentinel (Oath of the Ancients)
15.description: When dropped to 0 HP (not killed outright), drop to 1 HP instead and regain HP equal to 3x Paladin level once per Long Rest, and stop aging magically.

20.name: Elder Champion (Oath of the Ancients)
20.description: For 1 minute as a Bonus Action, regain 10 HP per turn, cast action spells as Bonus Actions, and impose Disadvantage on saves vs Paladin spells in your aura.

3.name: Vow of Enmity & Vengeance Spells (Oath of Vengeance)
3.description: Keep Vengeance spells prepared and expend Channel Divinity when hitting an enemy to gain Advantage on attacks against it for 1 minute.

7.name: Relentless Avenger (Oath of Vengeance)
7.description: When you hit with an Opportunity Attack, reduce the target's Speed to 0 and move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

15.name: Soul of Vengeance (Oath of Vengeance)
15.description: Use your Reaction to make an attack when the creature targeted by your Vow of Enmity makes an attack roll.

20.name: Avenging Angel (Oath of Vengeance)
20.description: For 10 minutes as a Bonus Action, gain a 60-foot Fly Speed and a 30-foot Frightening aura granting Advantage on attacks against frightened foes.
